item.adventurerspack.help: E/B: equipped pack | Right-click: held pack
upgrade.adventurerspack.pickup_rune: Routes collected drops into matching bulk slots, then the selected or routed tab.
upgrade.adventurerspack.gathering_rune: Collects nearby drops. Requires a Pickup Rune.
upgrade.adventurerspack.deep_pockets_run: Increases each bulk slot from 4,096 to 65,536 items by default.
upgrade.adventurerspack.provision_pouch: 18 food slots in Pouches. Automatically eats safe food; first slot has priority.
upgrade.adventurerspack.restock_rune: Tops up existing hotbar stacks; pinned bulk slots are protected.
upgrade.adventurerspack.crafting_kit: Right-click to pull a 3x3 crafting grid out beside the pack.
upgrade.adventurerspack.ember_core: Right-click to pull the furnace out. It keeps smelting while the pack is closed.
upgrade.adventurerspack.ender_chest: Right-click to pull your ender chest out beside the pack.
upgrade.adventurerspack.builders_belt: Enables placing the selected bulk block while holding the pack.
upgrade.adventurerspack.void_sigil: Optional overflow deletion for matching, full, unprotected bulk slots.
upgrade.adventurerspack.quiver: Holds arrows and rockets. Right-click to pull it out. Bows, crossbows, and elytra use it first.
upgrade.adventurerspack.philter: Three vials. Pour a potion in and the bottle comes back. U drinks or throws the selected vial.
upgrade.adventurerspack.alembic: Brews while carried or docked. Finished potions pour into an installed Philter.
key.adventurerspack.tool: Tool kit: tap to select the tool slot, hold to choose
upgrade.adventurerspack.tank_upgrade: Two tanks, 128 buckets each. Each tank keeps its own fluid. Open Tank, choose Tank 1 or Tank 2, then fill or empty it.
upgrade.adventurerspack.battery_upgrade: Stores 1,000,000 FE. The In slot drains an energy item. The Out slot charges one. Moves 1,000 FE per tick. Dock pipes can charge it.
upgrade.adventurerspack.xp_storage_upgra: Stores up to 200,000 experience points. Open XP to deposit or withdraw.
upgrade.adventurerspack.cave_torch: Holds torches in 9 slots and automatically places them in dark places nearby.
